title: EventBus different instance bound method identity contract

contract.different_instance_identity: Bound methods using the same class function but different target instances are treated as distinct callbacks
contract.same_function_different_target: Matching __func__ alone does not collapse callbacks when __self__ differs
contract.independent_registration: Each distinct handler instance may register its bound callback independently
contract.delivery: Both callbacks receive the emitted event
contract.callback_independence: Each handler instance receives its own callback invocation
contract.registry_stability: Multiple bound methods from different instances remain separate after emit
contract.permission_enforcement: Each registration and emit continues to require the events permission
